text:
alice: Heads-up — saw a tail-latency spike (~3-4x p99) on the canary with FIFO eviction enabled. Pattern shows long GC-like pauses during heavy long-context traffic.

bob: Which canary and what time? any logs or perf counters?

alice: canary-3, started ~18:12 UTC. quick perf dump attached below (sorry inline):
```
kv.evict.attempts: 124k
kv.evict.skipped_handshake: 11k
kv.evict.iteration_count_avg: 48
sched.evicter.yield_syscalls: 980
alloc.fragmentation_ratio: 1.28
latency.p99: 230ms (baseline 60ms)
```

carla: hmm "skipped_handshake" is interesting — that indicates the evicter loop saw a transient mismatch with the allocator handshake token and dropped the eviction attempt instead of continuing. if many small entries are fragmented across thin slabs FIFO tries to avoid moving them but ends up looping.

dinesh: do we have a repro? i can spin a loadtest that simulates many long contexts and repeated small-kv writes. thinking the evicter scheduling quantum might be too small, causing tight-spin then syscall yields.

alice: repro command (in perf-tests):
```
./bin/loadtest --clients 200 --ctx-len 65536 --write-pattern churn-small-keys --duration 10m --target canary-3
```

bob: i'll try that locally. if we can repro, quick mitigation is to increase eviction_budget to 2x or disable FIFO reinsertion fastpath for hot slabs.

carla: note a correctness worry: when FIFO reinserts entries we observed a rare ordering inversion under concurrent reinsert+pager that caused a logical double-free in our internal handle map. we logged a safety check but maybe it was suppressed under high load. need to confirm.

eve: plan: 1) reproduce in staging with loadtest (dinesh + bob), 2) add flamegraph and syscall trace to the evicter path (carla), 3) add a temporary safe-mode toggle to force LRU fallback on high-p95 eviction latency, 4) postmortem follow-up.

bob: on repro i see the same syscall-yield signature: the evicter loop doing tiny batches and thrashing. adding a 200us sleep in the loop removes the spike but that's a bandaid.

carla: here's the snippet i captured from the canary logs showing the evicter decision path (sanitized):
```
[evicter] start_batch idx=432 free_target=8192 budget=64
[evicter] scanned=120 evicted=0 reinserts=110 skipped_handshake=13
[allocator] slab_thin: split_count=47
[evicter] yield -> syscall(sched_yield)
[evicter] resumed batch idx=433 scanned=10 ...
```

dinesh: sounds like fragmentation + FIFO reinserts starve forward progress because reinserts keep bumping older items to tail; combined with a too-small batch budget the evicter never reaches the hot pages to actually free enough memory -> paging thrash.

alice: telemetry request: add histogram for evicter.batch_scanned, evicter.reinserts, evicter.skipped_handshake, and time_per_batch. we need to correlate with slab fragmentation ratio.

eve: agreed. also add an alert for evicter.time_per_batch.p99 > 50ms for 5m. that will auto-fire before SLA impact.

bob: for immediate mitigation i'm going to roll back the FIFO-reinsert micro-optimization introduced in commit `a1b2c3d` from last week on canary-3. will monitor.

pagerbot: canary-3: rollback triggered by bob at 19:03 UTC — status: in-progress. reason=latency spike triage. :wrench:

alice: after rollback p99 dropped back to ~70ms within two minutes. looks good so far.

carla: still want a proper fix: options = increase eviction_budget, implement adaptive batch sizing, or change reinsertion semantics (LRU-tilt on high-fragmentation). my vote: adaptive batch + safety checks to prevent reinserting looped items.

dinesh: i'll prototype adaptive batch sizing this week: increase budget when reinserts/skipped_handshake ratio > 0.1 and back off when p95 improves.

eve: assign owner for follow-up doc and postmortem: carla to lead, dinesh implement prototype, bob validate canary rollback + metric dashboards.

alice: thanks everyone. saving logs and traces to the incident S3 under `s3://rdw-perf/canary-3/2026-03-18-evicter` and note on the ticket.

bob: :thumbsup: keep updates here.

carla: added checklist to the ticket with a minimal repro and pointer to flamegraphs.

pagerbot: ticket RDW-4521 updated by carla — status: investigating.

alice: closing loop for now; will reopen if we see reoccurence after the rollback.
